summary: Explains the 'Show Member Detail' filter on the Admission Leads page, which allows a team lead to view not only their own assigned leads but also the aggregated leads of all members within their team.
steps: Navigate to the Admission Leads page.
Select a counselor (e.g., Sumit) from the filter.
With the 'Show Member Detail' toggle OFF, only Sumit's individual leads will be displayed.
With the 'Show Member Detail' toggle ON, all leads belonging to Sumit and his team members will be displayed collectively.
business_rules: This filter aggregates lead data for a team lead, providing an overview of their team's collective performance and pipeline.
important_notes: This filter is crucial for team leads to effectively monitor and manage their team's overall lead pipeline and activities.
questions: What is the purpose of the 'Show Member Detail' filter on the Admission Leads page?
How can a team lead view all leads managed by their team members?
What is the difference in lead display when the 'Show Member Detail' toggle is on versus off?
How does this filter help in team lead oversight?
